meta.description: Computational pathology workflows using PathML 3.0.5 for local research. Covers loading and tiling whole-slide images (OpenSlide/Bio-Formats), building preprocessing and QC pipelines, managing h5path data, quantifying multiplex images, constructing spatial graphs, and planning bounded model inference. Research-only tool with strong safety boundaries for PHI and clinical use restrictions.

scientific_integrity.detail: Exceptional safety boundaries: clear not-diagnostic disclaimers, PHI handling requirements, authorization/consent checks, de-identification mandates

practice_boundaries.detail: Explicit scope: local research only, not medical device/diagnostic/clinical decision support; strong workflow guidance with patient-level splits

methodological_ground.detail: Based on PathML 3.0.5 from Dana-Farber AIOS with peer-reviewed publications (Rosenthal 2022, Omar 2025); clear beta status documented

code_usability.detail: Production research workflows with bounded CLIs, provenance tracking, split enforcement, and model security guidance

functional_suitability.note: Complete pathology pipeline: slide loading (OpenSlide/Bio-Formats), preprocessing, QC, h5path, multiplex quantification, spatial graphs, inference

reliability.note: Excellent guidance: version reconciliation (3.0.5 PyPI vs GitHub releases), bounded pilot patterns, coordinate system documentation, network consent gates

performance_context.note: Strong optimization: bounded sampling (islice), tile/batch planning CLIs, memory estimation, CUDA guidance; SKILL.md 223 lines well-structured

agent_usability.note: Outstanding: 8-step research workflow, no-network default with explicit consent, model security section, 6 reference files, 6 bounded CLIs

human_usability.note: Clear triggers (PathML, whole-slide, computational pathology, histology), safety boundary upfront, version baseline section, scope statement

security.note: Exceptional: PHI handling protocol, no-network default, explicit consent for downloads, model trust warnings, pickle/ONNX security, no shadow modules

maintainability.note: Excellent structure: 6 reference files, version verification (2026-07-23), primary sources with DOIs, GPL-2.0 license disclosure, install documentation

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with OpenSlide/Bio-Formats/PyTorch; deterministic core; minor: multi-slide batch orchestration could be more explicit

key_strengths: Outstanding safety boundaries: explicit not-diagnostic disclaimers, comprehensive PHI handling protocol, authorization/consent/de-identification requirements upfront
Exceptional security guidance: no-network default with explicit consent gates, pickle vs ONNX trust model, shadow module warnings, isolation recommendations
Excellent version management: reconciles PyPI 3.0.5 vs GitHub releases, verifies sources 2026-07-23, documents beta status, clarifies license implications

Production research patterns with 6 bounded CLIs (URL/symlink rejection, no PathML import for --help, resource planning, strict JSON)

recommendations.title: Add explicit enforcement guidance for pseudonymous ID requirements
recommendations.problem: Pseudonymous IDs required in filenames/logs/labels but no validation or enforcement mechanism documented
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on stating requirements rather than providing validation tools
recommendations.fix: Add CLI script validate_anonymization.py that scans filenames, h5path labels, and logs for common PHI patterns (SSN, MRN formats, dates, names from allowlist) and flags violations before analysis begins

recommendations.title: Add multi-slide batch orchestration guidance
recommendations.problem: Single-slide workflows clear but batch processing across patient cohorts not explicitly documented
recommendations.root_cause: Examples focus on demonstrating API rather than production batch patterns
recommendations.fix: Add reference/batch_processing.md covering manifest iteration, error handling per slide, progress tracking, failed-slide recovery, and batch provenance aggregation
